description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for the Notes application, handling UI rendering, state management, and interactions with a backend API for CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages notes, handles fetching from backend, and renders the UI.

methods.description: Handles creating a new note by sending a POST request to the backend.

methods.description: Handles deleting a note by sending a DELETE request to the backend.
